title: Manager, Social & Creator Marketing
description:
CHAGEE (pronounced CHAH-jee) is a modern teahouse with more than 7,500 locations globally.

We are a global brand with proud roots in Yunnan, committed to bringing people together through tea. CHAGEE is awakening a modern tea movement, grounded in authentic heritage, fueled by cutting edge innovation, and crafted to nourish body and spirit.

Overview

Elevate your career with CHAGEE as Manager, Social & Creator Marketing.

Through our stores across China, Asia Pacific, and the United States, we serve a staggering 100 million cups of tea monthly. CHAGEE is excited to expand its presence in the US market. This is your chance to be part of an exhilarating journey as we deliver the taste of authentic tea culture to America.

The Role

The Manager, Social & Creator Marketing will own the strategy and day-to-day stewardship of CHAGEE USA social channels, content ecosystem, creator program, and community engagement. This person will translate brand, product, and teahouse priorities into culturally resonant storytelling that feels distinctive to CHAGEE and native to each platform.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. The right person has a strong creative point of view, understands how culture moves, knows how to build trusted creator relationships, and uses performance signals to make the work stronger.

The Modern Tea Movement starts with you. At CHAGEE, we're connecting the world through modern tea — making friends, pouring tea, and building careers along the way. Join a team rooted in tradition, fueled by purpose, and scaling a global movement across North America.

What You Will Own

•
Social strategy: Set the owned social vision, channel roles, audience strategy, editorial priorities, and annual roadmap across current and emerging platforms.

•
Content leadership: Build the content calendar and lead the development of social first ideas across campaigns, launches, evergreen storytelling, cultural moments, and teahouse experiences.

•
Creative direction and content creation: Bring a strong social eye and clear visual point of view to every piece of content. Write strong briefs, establish the creative bar, and partner with internal creative teams, agencies, photographers, videographers, and creators to produce distinctive work. This person should also be comfortable designing, capturing, editing, and producing social content directly when needed.

•
Creator marketing: Define the creator strategy across community voices, emerging talent, tastemakers, and larger partners. Lead identification, relationship development, briefing, contracting, amplification, and measurement.

•
Community building: Develop programs that turn followers, members, students, and local communities into active participants and advocates for CHAGEE.

•
Cultural intelligence: Identify relevant conversations, behaviors, formats, and partnerships while protecting the integrity of the brand.

•
Integrated planning: Connect social and creator work to product launches, retail marketing, digital, loyalty, public relations, events, and the full teahouse consumer journey.

•
Performance and learning: Define meaningful measures of success, read platform and business signals, share clear insights, and continually improve content, creator investment, and channel performance.

•
Agency and budget leadership: Manage agency partners, creator investment, production resources, timelines, and budgets with clarity and accountability.

•
Team building: Establish effective ways of working now and help shape the future social and creator organization as CHAGEE grows.

What You Bring

•
Approximately 5 to 10 years of relevant experience across social media, content, creator marketing, community, or integrated brand marketing.

•
Meaningful brand side experience within a culturally relevant consumer, lifestyle, hospitality, beauty, wellness, retail, or food and beverage business.

•
Demonstrated ownership of an organic social strategy and content calendar, with the judgment to balance long term brand building and timely cultural participation.

•
Strong creator marketing experience across strategy, relationship building, briefing, negotiation, activation, amplification, and measurement.

•
A sharp creative eye and the ability to evaluate an idea, improve a brief, direct content, and protect a consistent brand point of view.

•
Comfort moving from strategic planning into hands on execution in a fast growing environment.

•
Strong cross functional leadership, communication, agency management, and prioritization skills.

•
Fluency in social analytics and the ability to connect engagement, conversation, audience growth, traffic, trial, and business outcomes.

•
Experience building culturally inclusive work for diverse audiences. Multicultural or Asian American audience experience is valuable.

•
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

•
CHAGEE has a clear and differentiated social point of view, not simply a posting calendar.

•
Content quality and consistency improve while the team becomes faster and more culturally responsive.

•
Creators operate as trusted storytellers and community partners, not only as paid distribution.

•
Product launches and teahouse moments are amplified through cohesive owned, creator, and community storytelling.

•
The function has a practical measurement framework that informs decisions and connects social activity to broader brand and business priorities.

What We Offer

•
Hybrid work schedule for a balanced life

•
401K with company match to secure your future

•
Yearly bonus opportunity

•
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

•
On-site fitness center and wellness programs

•
Exclusive discounts at our tea locations, theme parks, and gyms

•
Generous paid time off starting at 15 days, plus 7 federal holidays

•
Opportunities for continuous education and scholarships

•
Income protection including Disability, Life, and AD&D insurance

•
Bereavement leave for those difficult times

•

Join our team and be part of a brand that's as refreshing as our tea! We're excited to see how your talents will help us grow and create memorable experiences for our customers.

The estimated total cash compensation for this position is $101,400 — $152,250, inclusive of base salary and estimated bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate and may vary depending on factors including (but not limited to): relevant knowledge and experience, skills, education, certifications, overall qualifications, and your specific work location.

CHAGEE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

title: Sr. Facilities & Equipment Specialist (Contract)
description:
About the job

CHAGEE (pronounced CHAH-jee) is a modern teahouse with more than 7,500 locations globally.

We are a global brand with proud roots in Yunnan, committed to bringing people together through tea. CHAGEE is awakening a modern tea movement, grounded in authentic heritage, fueled by cutting edge innovation, and crafted to nourish body and spirit.

Overview

Elevate your career with CHAGEE as a Sr. Facilities & Equipment Specialist

Through our stores across China, Asia Pacific, and the United States, we serve a staggering 100 million cups of tea monthly. CHAGEE is excited to expand its presence in the US market. This is your chance to be part of an exhilarating journey as we deliver the taste of authentic tea culture to America.

The Modern Tea Movement starts with you. At CHAGEE, we're connecting the world through modern tea — making friends, pouring tea, and building careers along the way. Join a team rooted in tradition, fueled by purpose, and scaling a global movement across North America.

The Senior Facilities & Equipment Specialist is responsible for supporting the day to day operational readiness of our stores by serving as the primary point of contact for equipment, maintenance, repair, and general facilities related issues.

This role acts as the first line of support when stores experience equipment or facility problems. The Specialist will assess and troubleshoot issues, provide store teams with appropriate guidance, coordinate service vendors when necessary, and ensure issues are followed through to resolution.

The goal of this position is to establish clear ownership of store maintenance and facilities support while reducing the need for routine issues to be escalated directly to Operations, R&D, or other cross functional leaders. These teams will remain available as technical resources for complex issues, but this position will own the day-to-day coordination and resolution process.

What You'll Do

Store Facilities & Equipment Support

• Serve as the primary point of contact for store equipment, maintenance, and facilities issues.

• Receive, assess, prioritize, and track maintenance requests from store teams.

• Troubleshoot equipment issues remotely with store teams when appropriate.

• Determine whether an issue can be resolved through store level troubleshooting, requires internal technical support, or requires a service vendor.

• Provide clear instructions to store teams for basic troubleshooting and corrective actions.

• Escalate complex or recurring technical issues to Operations, R&D, IT, equipment manufacturers, or other appropriate teams.

• Follow issues through resolution rather than simply referring stores to another department.

• Communicate issue status, expected timelines, and next steps to store leadership.

Equipment Maintenance & Repair

Support the operation and maintenance of equipment used throughout our stores, including:

• Tea brewing equipment

• Automated beverage dispensing equipment

• Espresso machines and grinders

• Ice machines

• Water filtration and reverse osmosis systems

• Refrigeration and freezer equipment

• Blenders, mixers, and other beverage preparation equipment

• Smallwares and other store operational equipment

Responsibilities may include:

• Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, plumbing, water-system, and equipment-related problems within the scope of the role.

• Performing basic repairs and component replacements when appropriate.

• Coordinating manufacturer or third-party service when specialized repair is required.

• Identifying repeat equipment failures and working with Operations and R&D to determine root causes.

• Maintaining records of equipment failures, repairs, parts replacement, and service history.

Preventive Maintenance

• Develop and maintain preventive maintenance schedules for store equipment.

• Ensure required maintenance is completed at appropriate intervals.

• Coordinate preventive maintenance visits with stores and service providers.

• Identify equipment showing signs of premature wear or repeated failure.

• Maintain recommended spare parts and critical replacement components where appropriate.

• Establish standards for routine equipment care that can be performed by store teams.

• Work with Training and Operations to ensure store teams understand basic equipment care and maintenance expectations.

Vendor & Service Management

• Coordinate service calls with approved equipment and facilities vendors.

• Communicate technical information and store conditions to vendors before service visits.

• Track open service requests and ensure work is completed.

• Review service recommendations and determine appropriate next steps with internal stakeholders when necessary.

• Maintain relationships with equipment manufacturers, distributors, technicians, and service providers.

• Help evaluate vendor responsiveness, repair quality, cost, and recurring service issues.

• Maintain service reports, warranties, equipment manuals, vendor contacts, and related documentation.

Facilities Support

Support general store facilities needs, including issues related to:

• Plumbing

• Electrical systems

• HVAC

• Refrigeration

• Water systems

• Fixtures and millwork

• Doors and hardware

• Lighting

• Drainage

• General store repairs

Determine when issues can be handled internally and when licensed or specialized contractors are required.

New Store Openings & Equipment Installation

• Support equipment installation, commissioning, and testing for new store openings.

• Coordinate with Operations, R&D, vendors, contractors, and store teams to ensure equipment is installed correctly and operational prior to opening.

• Verify equipment connections, utilities, placement, and basic functionality.

• Assist with identifying and resolving installation deficiencies.

• Maintain equipment information and service documentation for newly opened locations.

Documentation & Issue Tracking

• Maintain an organized equipment and facilities service history for each store.

• Track recurring issues and identify patterns across locations.

• Maintain equipment information including model numbers, serial numbers, warranty information, installation dates, and service history.

• Document troubleshooting procedures and common resolutions.

• Help develop and maintain a troubleshooting knowledge base for store teams.

• Provide periodic reporting on open issues, recurring failures, repair costs, and equipment reliability.

Qualifications

• 3–5+ years of experience in facilities, equipment maintenance, field service, restaurant equipment, foodservice equipment, or a related technical role.

• Strong mechanical and technical troubleshooting skills.

• Working knowledge of electrical, plumbing, refrigeration, water filtration, and commercial foodservice equipment.

• Ability to diagnose problems remotely using conversations, photos, videos, error codes, and equipment documentation.

• Experience coordinating third-party technicians and service vendors.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open service requests across multiple locations.

• Comfortable reading equipment manuals, technical documentation, manufacturer specifications, and basic electrical or mechanical diagrams.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues into clear instructions for store teams.

• Ability to distinguish between issues that can be resolved internally and those requiring licensed or specialized contractors.

• Ability to travel between store locations as needed.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of issues through resolution.

What We Offer

• Hybrid work schedule for a balanced life

• 401K with company match to secure your future

• Yearly bonus opportunity

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• On-site fitness center and wellness programs

• Exclusive discounts at our tea locations, theme parks, and gyms

• Generous paid time off starting at 15 days, plus 7 federal holidays

• Opportunities for continuous education and scholarships

• Income protection including Disability, Life, and AD&D insurance

• Bereavement leave for those difficult times

Join our team and be part of a brand that's as refreshing as our tea! We're excited to see how your talents will help us grow and create memorable experiences for our customers. Final compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate and may vary depending on factors including (but not limited to): relevant knowledge and experience, skills, education, certifications, overall qualifications, and your specific work location.

Final compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate and may vary depending on factors including (but not limited to): relevant knowledge and experience, skills, education, certifications, overall qualifications, and your specific work location.

title: Director, Supply Chain
description:
CHAGEE (pronounced CHAH-jee) is a modern teahouse with more than 7,500 locations globally.

We are a global brand with proud roots in Yunnan, committed to bringing people together through tea. CHAGEE is awakening a modern tea movement, grounded in authentic heritage, fueled by cutting edge innovation, and crafted to nourish body and spirit.

Overview:

Elevate your career with CHAGEE as Director, Head of Supply Chain - North America.

Through our stores across China, Asia Pacific, and the United States, we serve a staggering 100 million cups of tea monthly. CHAGEE is excited to expand its presence in the US market. This is your chance to be part of an exhilarating journey as we deliver the taste of authentic tea culture to America.

Chagee is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Supply Chain, Director – North America, to lead end-to-end supply chain operations across North America, ensuring availability, efficiency, quality, and scalability as the business expands. This role will oversee demand planning, procurement, logistics, inventory management, and supplier partnerships, while aligning closely with global supply chain standards and supporting local operational needs. The ideal candidate has deep experience in food & beverage or retail supply chain management, strong analytical and leadership skills, and thrives in high-growth environments.

The Modern Tea Movement starts with you. At CHAGEE, we're connecting the world through modern tea — making friends, pouring tea, and building careers along the way. Join a team rooted in tradition, fueled by purpose, and scaling a global movement across North America.

What you'll do:

•
Lead and manage the full supply chain function across North America, covering demand planning, sourcing, procurement, logistics, and inventory operations — and build a healthy ecosystem and excellent relationships with all vendors.

•
Develop and implement regional supply chain strategies aligned with global direction and tailored to local business needs.

•
Ensure consistent and timely product availability across stores while maintaining optimal inventory levels.

•
Build and manage a regional supplier network, including contract negotiation, performance management, and risk mitigation.

•
Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, including importation, warehousing, and distribution operations.

•
Partner with Store Development, Operations, and R&D teams to support new store launches, product rollouts, and market expansion.

•
Support new product R&D with fast response and high quality & reliable delivery, leveraging vendor sourcing and exploration of new sources of supply.

•
Lead S&OP processes, integrating forecasting, financial planning, and demand signals into procurement and logistics planning.

•
Monitor supply chain KPIs (e.g., fill rate, cost-to-serve, lead times, shrinkage), with a particular focus on COGS improvement and out-of-stock control, and drive continuous improvement.

•
Ensure compliance with U.S., Canadian, and Mexican regulations on food safety, traceability, labeling, customs, and environmental requirements.

•
Build and develop a high-performing supply chain team to support long-term regional growth.

•
Maintain strong communication and stakeholder engagement across global and local vendors, and global and regional teams.

Experience/Qualifications you need to be successful:

•
10+ years of experience in supply chain management, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role; food & beverage, QSR, or retail industry experience strongly preferred.

•
Proven success managing multi-country supply chain operations, including supplier management, logistics, and inventory planning.

•
Strong understanding of North American import/export procedures, food regulations, and cross-border logistics.

•
Experience implementing or working with supply chain systems (ERP, WMS, forecasting tools).

•
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

•
